# SRATECH

> SRATECH is a software development company based in Delhi NCR, India, building custom websites, web and mobile apps, custom software, WhatsApp chatbots, AI automation and cloud/DevOps for businesses across India and internationally (US, UK, UAE, Australia). Clients own 100% of their source code — no vendor lock-in. Every website package includes 1 year of free domain and hosting plus 24×7 support.

## Key facts

- **What we do:** Website development, web & mobile app development, custom software, AI automation, WhatsApp chatbots, cloud & DevOps.
- **Where:** Delhi NCR (Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, Faridabad, Ghaziabad), serving all of India and remote clients worldwide.
- **Starter website:** from ₹6,999, including 1 year free domain & hosting and 24×7 support.
- **Mobile apps:** Basic app from ₹69,999; Business app from ₹1,49,999 (Android & iOS).
- **Custom web app / software:** from ₹1,49,999, scoped after a short audit.
- **E-commerce websites:** from ₹59,999.
- **Code ownership:** On final payment, all source code, design files and repository access transfer to the client. No lock-in, no licence fees.
- **Registration:** MSME · Udyam Registered — UDYAM-DL-10-0131847.
- **Contact:** Email contact@sratech.net · Phone/WhatsApp +91 85889 30331.
- **Website:** https://sratech.net/

- [Website Development](https://sratech.net/web-development/): Fast, SEO-ready business websites from ₹6,999 with free domain, hosting and support.
